title: Referências bibliográficas que fundamentam a teoria filosófico-espiritualista desenvolvida neste livro:

queries.text: Bibliography convention (as in Magnetism in Social Relations): titles of the Brazilian editions the author used are translated into English (the established English title is used when one exists); authors, translators, years, cities, publishers, and pages are kept; labels are translated (trad. → trans., orgs. → eds., sem data → n.d., Original de → Original from). Obvious misspellings of names in the original are corrected: Crhistina → Christina, Johan → Johann, Oliveria → Oliveira, Gehard → Gerhard, Theodosios → Theodosius, Salmanshon → Salmansohn, Shanon → Shannon.
Brazilian edition "O Erotismo: Fantasias e Realidades do Amor e da Sedução"; the Italian original is "L'erotismo" (1986). The title of the English edition, if any, was not verified.

Original "Desilusões Amorosas Fazem Mal ao Coração In: Jornal Bus: A Informação que Não Para"; program name "Jornal Bus" and company name kept. Date "16/10/2007" converted to month/day; "23 horas e 10 minutos" given as 23:10.

Brazilian edition "Sexo Privilegiado: O Fim do Mito da Fragilidade Feminina"; the English original is "The Privileged Sex" (2013 edition; Hebrew/German editions earlier). Subtitle translated from the Portuguese.

English originals: "Promises and Pitfalls of the Spiritual Path" in "Spiritual Emergency: When Personal Transformation Becomes a Crisis" (1989). The Brazilian subtitle is translated here; the same applies to 34-0018 and 34-0028.
Brazilian edition "O Homem em Evolução"; English original "Mankind Evolving" (1962; the author gives 1961).
"Dicionário Aurélio Básico da Língua Portuguesa" translated; "Folha de São Paulo" is the newspaper's name.
"Pedagogia da Autonomia"; the English edition is titled "Pedagogy of Freedom: Ethics, Democracy, and Civic Courage" (1998). Translated the Brazilian title literally.
The English original is "Emotional Intelligence: Why It Can Matter More Than IQ" (1995); the subtitle here is translated from the Brazilian edition.
English original "She: Understanding Feminine Psychology"; subtitle translated from the Brazilian edition.
"O Eu e o Inconsciente" corresponds to Jung's "The Relations between the Ego and the Unconscious" (Collected Works, vol. 7). Translated the Brazilian title literally.
The English edition is titled "Animus and Anima"; the order of the Brazilian title is kept.

Title translated from the Brazilian edition ("Dogma e Ritual de Alta Magia"), as in Magnetism in Social Relations. Waite's English translation is "Transcendental Magic: Its Doctrine and Ritual" (1896).
The original gives the Portuguese form of the name, "MAQUIAVEL, Nicholau"; rendered with the English/Italian form.

Brazilian title "Como Adestrar seu Homem em Mais ou Menos 21 Dias" translated literally; the English original is "How to Make Your Man Behave in 21 Days or Less Using the Secrets of Professional Dog Trainers" (1994).

English original "The Invisible Partners: How the Male and Female in Each of Us Affects Our Relationships" (1980); subtitle translated from the Brazilian edition. Likewise 34-0059: "Evil: The Shadow Side of Reality" (1981).

Brazilian edition "O Matrimônio Perfeito: Porta de Entrada à Iniciação"; Samael Aun Weor's book is known in English as "The Perfect Matrimony". 34-0066: "Tratado de Psicologia Revolucionária" is known in English as "Treatise of Revolutionary Psychology" / "Revolutionary Psychology".
Original "A Batalha de Riddick (Chronics of Riddick)": the Brazilian release title followed by a misspelled English title; given here with the correct English title only.
Original "Hitch: Conselheiro Amoroso" (Brazilian release title); the English title is simply "Hitch".
Spanish-language edition in the original ("Estudios sobre la Histeria", "Obras Completas"); titles translated into English like the rest of the list.
The original gives "GOLEMAN, David"; the editor of "Healing Emotions" is Daniel Goleman, so the first name was corrected.
Spanish-language edition in the original ("Lo Inconsciente en la Vida Psíquica Normal y Patológica"); title translated into English.
Spanish-language edition in the original ("La Genealogia de la Moral"); title given in English.
The German original title in parentheses is kept as in the original ("Das" is German here). The Brazilian publisher's name keeps "Ltda." (part of the company name).
